mod.name: Video Track
mod.author: noctaur
mod.description: Drop a video file on an arranger track: its sound goes in as an audio clip that is the video, with a film strip (above the waveform or over it), and the picture plays in a Video panel that follows the clips through moves, cuts and trims. The panel's button is in the bottom bar, or with a panel layout mod's view buttons; right-click a video clip > Video > Detach Video to a Window shows the picture without it. Several videos (the highest AV track shows), a detachable window, ffmpeg or mpv included.
